properties.description: Migrated from DataStage Server Job 'JRenameIBM' (JobType=0, Category=\Jobs\Utilitarios). BeforeSubr: DSU.fncCreaArchivoVacio. AfterSubr: DSU.ExecSH FileRename $PathInput IBMFileName. Renames IBM source file after processing to mark it as consumed. ADF: Databricks notebook nb_FileRename renames file in ADLS.

activities.name: RenameIBMFile
activities.description: Rename IBM mainframe source file after processing. Maps to DataStage AfterSubr: DSU.ExecSH #$PathShell#FileRename #$PathInput# #IBMFileName#. In ADLS: renames file from IBMFileName to IBMFileName.PROCESADO.{timestamp}.

PathTemp.description: Temp path (used for Vacio.tmp BeforeSubr). Maps to $PathTemp.

IBMFileName.description: IBM source file name to rename. Maps to #IBMFileName# local param. Example: EDWOS.TRANSBK.MCF.CUENTA.TXT
